title: Cleaning up after your dog
question: Am I obligated to clean up after my dog in Poland?
short_answer: Yes. Dog owners must clean up their dog's waste in public spaces.
conditions: Owners must immediately remove their dog's faeces from public spaces
Bags are often available at dispensers in parks
Waste must be disposed of in designated bins (pojemnik na psie odchody)
Municipal regulations apply in all cities
exceptions: Guide dogs (psy przewodniki) may have exemptions in some regulations
penalties: Fine: 50–500 PLN for failing to clean up after your dog
